name: claude-usage-analyzer
description: Analyzes how you actually use Claude -- local Desktop/Cowork/CLI data plus an optional claude.ai account export -- and turns it into a live, self-updating dashboard: which chats belong in which Projects, what each Project's name/description/custom instructions and file structure should be, and what's stale vs. active. Read-only analysis only; never moves, renames, or deletes anything on its own.
